name: Bra Size Calculator
author: Md Shariful Islam

sections.faq:
Does the calculator guarantee that a bra will fit?

No. It estimates a reference size. Brand charts and fit can differ, so check the specific product’s size guide.

Can visitors switch between inches and centimeters?

Yes. The calculator includes inch and centimeter controls.

Can I choose a default country?

Yes. Set the default country and country selector display in Settings > Bra Size Calculator.

Does the shortcode accept styling parameters?

No. Use the plugin settings page to customize supported appearance options.

sections.description:
Estimate bra sizes from underbust and bust measurements with inch/cm input, 31 country options, and regional size conversions. Visitors enter underbust and bust measurements, choose inches or centimeters, select a country, and receive an estimated bra size with international size conversions. Use the [brasical_size_calculator] shortcode to add a bra measurement calculator to a page or post. The plugin includes country and unit selectors, measurement validation, a result dialog, regional size conversions, and an admin live preview with appearance controls.

Features

  • Estimate a bra size from underbust and bust measurements.
  • Accept measurements in inches or centimeters.
  • Offer 31 country selections across South Asia, North America, Europe, East Asia, and Oceania.
  • Show reference size conversions for South Asia, US/Canada, UK/Ireland, Europe, France/Spain, Italy, Japan/South Korea, and Australia/New Zealand.
  • Let site administrators set a default country, show or hide the country selector, and display country flags.
  • Customize country selector colors and radius, unit button colors, border, font size and font family, calculator button colors and hover colors, and button alignment.
  • Preview appearance changes in the WordPress admin area.

How It Works

  1. Measure snugly around the body directly under the bust for the underbust measurement.
  2. Measure around the fullest part of the bust without compressing it.
  3. Enter both measurements, select the measurement unit and country, then calculate.

Supported Countries

  • South Asia: Bangladesh (BD), India (IN), Pakistan (PK), Nepal (NP), Sri Lanka (LK), Maldives (MV), Bhutan (BT).
  • North America: United States (US), Canada (CA).
  • Europe: United Kingdom (UK), Ireland (IE), Germany (DE), Netherlands (NL), Spain (ES), Italy (IT), France (FR), Sweden (SE), Norway (NO), Denmark (DK), Finland (FI), Austria (AT), Belgium (BE), Portugal (PT), Greece (GR), Poland (PL), Czech Republic (CZ), Hungary (HU).
  • East Asia: Japan (JP), South Korea (KR).
  • Oceania: Australia (AU), New Zealand (NZ).

Add the Calculator

  1. Install and activate Bra Size Calculator from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Open Settings > Bra Size Calculator to choose the default country and customize the calculator appearance.
  3. Add [brasical_size_calculator] to a page or post.

The shortcode has no attributes. Configure its appearance on the plugin settings page.

Sizing References and Fit

The calculator returns an estimated reference size, not a guaranteed fit. Bra sizing is not governed by one universal country or brand standard, and fit can vary by manufacturer, style, and body shape. Treat the result as a starting point and check the size chart for the brand being purchased.

  • South Asian sizing uses an India-market reference; a separate national chart could not be verified for every listed South Asian country.
  • Regional label conversions are referenced against Triumph’s international size chart.
  • Measurement guidance references Wacoal America’s fit calculator, Wacoal Singapore’s fit guide, and Berlei Australia’s size charts.

Privacy

Measurements are processed by the calculator in the visitor’s browser. The plugin does not save submitted measurements to the WordPress database.
